They call out to warn their fellows at the smallest sense of threat. A successful hunt here means staying silent and hidden right up until the decisive strike.

<b>Brushflits</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small flying creatures who live in flocks and flee at the first sign of danger.<ref>Brushflit [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Tiny, timid creatures that huddle in flocks and flee at the first hint of danger."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Brushflits sit in flocks and fly away when Hornet approaches. They are unable to damage Hornet in any way.

Brushflits respawn upon re-entering a room in slightly varying numbers and positions. Due to their speed, [[Tools]] or [[Skills|Silk Skills]] may be more effective at defeating them than [[Needle]] attacks.

A good location for filling their [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry is west of the Far Fields Bellway. 

== Location ==
Brushflits can be found in the [[Far Fields]]. Their number and location in the room change upon re-entering.
